maya: Quick sync — we canaryed the q4f16 quantized bring-up in ap-southeast and saw p95 drift vs us-west. Need concrete Dedicated sizing + autoscale margins for H100 vs A100. SLO: p95 < 200ms. Share numbers and short recs pls.

sahil: Was batching continuous or per-request? Also what's the typical seq distribution?

maya: Continuous batching enabled. Typical seq = 128, ~10% of requests hit ~512 tails. Canary raw from bench-bot below.

bench-bot: ```
run_id: canary-2026-03-19-20
region: ap-southeast
model: my-llm-q4f16
kernel: flash-attn (default)
H100-80GB: conc=6 -> qps=320 req/s, tokens/s=48k, p50=85ms, p95=140ms
A100-80GB: conc=6 -> qps=210 req/s, tokens/s=31k, p50=130ms, p95=220ms
H100-8conc-tail512: p95=210ms
A100-4conc-tail512: p95=260ms
notes: batching window=20ms, KV cache warm after ~3k steps
```

eva: TL;DR: A100 at same concurrency hits p95 > SLO. For Dedicated sizing i'd propose different concurrency targets: H100 -> target 7 (safe 8 for head spikes), A100 -> target 3-4. With q4 quant we see slower GEMM kernels on A100 unless we force triton kernels instead of some older cuBLAS paths.

ryan: For autoscale policy, plan for surge margin not < 25%. Practically we use: `min_nodes = ceil(baseline_nodes * 1.3)` and `scale_up_step = max(1, ceil(total_gpus * 0.15))`. That buys room for seq-tail bursts and model rollouts.

sahil: Can you share quick capacity calc? e.g., how many H100s for 10k concurrent requests typical mix?

eva: Rough calc: use per-GPU concurrency = 8 (H100, quant). So GPUs_needed = ceil(10_000 / 8) = 1250 GPUs. Add margin -> 1250 * 1.25 = ~1563 -> round for pods/nodes. For A100 using conc=4 -> GPUs_needed = 2500 -> with 1.25 margin = ~3125. Big diff; choose region routing or autoscale on H100.

maya: Important: region differences matter. us-west measurements show A100 closer to H100 for this model (kernel improvements landed there). ap-southeast still on older runtime image. So immediate mitigation: 1) prefer H100 pools in apac for this model, 2) bump autoscale margin to 30% while we backport kernel fixes.

jonathan: I'll run a multi-length bench tonight: seq=16/128/512 with flash-attn vs triton kernels and post results. ETA ~3h. I'll also test if forcing `--use-triton` narrows A100 gap.

maya: Also add a graceful degrade route: if p95 > 250ms for >1min, route %, or fallback to distilled model (latency optimized) in same pool. Add to runbook.

ryan: Agree. For Dedicated contracts: recommend selling committed H100 capacity for APAC customers; A100 can be cheaper but needs 2-2.5x GPUs for same SLO w/ this quant profile.

bench-bot: Canary logs posted: https://internal/bench/1770332211/results (contains CSV & flame graphs).

maya: Action items:
- jonathan: run targeted kernel/seq benches and upload results (assigned)
- eng-platform: update autoscale policy to min_nodes=ceil(baseline*1.3) and scale_step config (ryan to PR)
- infra: create a dedicated H100 surge pool in ap-southeast (maya to coord sales/infra)

anything else? :eyes:
